sentences.text: Conchoraptor was a small dinosaur measuring between 1 and 2 meters in length.
Unlike many other oviraptorids, this animal did not possess a head crest.
It lacked teeth and instead had powerful beaks, which may have been adapted for crushing mollusk shells.
The skull of Conchoraptor was heavily pneumatized, meaning most of its bones were hollow.
Internal connections between its ears functioned as resonance chambers that improved its hearing.
Conchoraptor gracilis was discovered in 1971 by a Polish-Mongolian expedition in the Red Beds of Hermiin Tsav and described by Rinchen Barsbold in 1986.
The type species Conchoraptor gracilis was formally described and named by Barsbold in 1986.
The genus name Conchoraptor combines the Greek word for 'mussel' and the Latin word for 'plunderer'.
The unique anatomy of Conchoraptor's hands was a primary factor in distinguishing it from Oviraptor as a separate genus.
The configuration of Conchoraptor's jaw suggests it fed on mollusks.
A 2022 study suggests that Conchoraptor possessed a very strong bite force when compared to other oviraptorosaurs.
Conchoraptor is classified within the family Oviraptoridae.
Conchoraptor belongs to the subfamily Ingeniinae.
Recent analyses classify Conchoraptor as a member of the oviraptorid subfamily Heyuanninae (formerly Ingeniinae).
Barsbold originally assigned Conchoraptor to the family Oviraptoridae in 1986.
Fossils of Conchoraptor are known from the Barun Goyot and possibly the Nemegt formations in Mongolia.
The Baruungoyot Formation in Mongolia, where Conchoraptor fossils were found, dates to the Maastrichtian stage.
During the Late Cretaceous, the environment of the Baruun Goyot Formation was arid, featuring sand dune fields and only intermittent streams.
The Nemegt Formation in Mongolia is estimated to date from the Maastrichtian stage, between 70 and 66 million years ago.
During the Late Cretaceous, the Nemegt Formation featured an arid environment with sand dune fields and intermittent streams.
Barsbold hypothesized that oviraptorids like Conchoraptor specialized in feeding on mollusks rather than primarily preying on eggs.
It is debated whether oviraptorosaurs were powerful-biting generalists or specialists that utilized niche partitioning based on body size and cranial function.
